versions.subject: on behalf of @socprime [SOC Prime Inc.](https://my.socprime.com/en/tdm/) add rules for Zeek. This includes Windows Event Channel Security EventID:5145 that have same fields as Zeek SMB Also, converted some of (MITRE ATT&CK BZAR)[https://github.com/mitre-attack/bzar] which are Zeek (sensor) scripts.
versions.detection:
selection1:
    name: \\*\IPC$
    path:
     - '*-stdin'
     - '*-stdout'
     - '*-stderr'
selection2:
    name: \\*\IPC$
    path: 'PSEXESVC*'
condition: selection1 and not selection2
